cornerstone.why_it_matters: named investors who asked for an allocation before pricing: demand the book already had, and often a sign the deal was covered before the roadshow ended

directed_share_program.why_it_matters: shares reserved for employees and friends; small, and they are not locked up the same way

controlled_company.why_it_matters: the founder or sponsor keeps control; governance discount and a large future supply

dual_class.why_it_matters: a second voting class; the free float may be a small slice of the company

material_weakness.why_it_matters: the auditor found a control failure; common in small IPOs, it shows up in the first 10-Q

going_concern.phrase: "substantial doubt about its ability to continue"
going_concern.why_it_matters: the IPO money is what keeps the company alive
